item.title: Version 4.11.0
item.description:
• When several sessions need you, the cards stack: the next one peeks out under the card on screen, with who it is and how long it's waited. Click it to bring it forward, or press ⌃⌥N
  • Every session wears its agent's own mark: Claude Code's ✻, Codex's >_, Gemini's ✦, moving while the agent works. The colour dots are gone, so Peek is the only colour in the notch
  • Sessions in the same repo group together, Conductor workspaces and worktrees included, and the group says how many need you
  • One type scale across the notch, the menu and Settings: a touch larger, and easier to read at a glance

item.title: Version 4.10.0
item.description:
• Peek comes in colours: pick a finish, then a colour, in Settings → Character
  • New Balloon finish: satin bubble letters in hot pink, sky, lemon and lilac
  • Gummy looks like real jelly now, in cherry, lime, tangerine and a new grape
  • Obsidian in black, midnight, plum and forest, Porcelain in white, sage, blush and sky, and Gold in gold, rose and white gold, with a warmer, cleaner shine
  • Chrome, Holo and Frosted are retired: if you used one, Peek switches to Neon

item.title: Version 4.9.2
item.description:
• Cards open out of the pill and fold back into it, with Peek staying on screen the whole way
  • The pill grows out of the notch when a session starts and tucks back in when the last one ends
  • Smoother edges on Peek: no more jagged rim light
  • Chrome looks like real chrome now: a bright mirror face, a crisp horizon, the state colour as a reflection

item.title: Version 4.9.1
item.description: • Peek no longer gets clipped at the bottom while swinging for you in the notch

item.title: Version 4.9.0
item.description:
• A 30-second practice run on first launch: allow one, answer one, reply to one (Settings → General to replay)
  • Context meter: sessions past half full show how full, and one heads-up before a known window fills
  • Ghostty: jump straight to the session's terminal (Ghostty 1.3+)
  • Cleaner cards: less text, no "just now"
